news.headline: Betty’s renews Keep A Breast partnership for October
news.summary: MariMed announced a fourth annual collaboration, pink Ache Away packaging, and a retail round-up initiative at participating Thrive dispensaries. The campaign supports breast health education.

news.headline: Perk Up Pumpkin joins the fall lineup
news.summary: The seasonal pumpkin spice latte chew joins the Massachusetts fall portfolio. Each chew has 5mg THC, 5mg CBC and 5mg CBG. Confirm availability locally.

news.headline: Betty’s introduces Bite-a-Mins
news.summary: MariMed expanded the core portfolio with tropical smoothie chews combining CBD, full-spectrum cannabis, Vitamin C, zinc and Vitamin D3. The July announcement responds to demand for higher-CBD options.

news.headline: Betty’s Eddies campaign gets Massachusetts news coverage
news.summary: Talking Joints Memo covered the October Keep A Breast collaboration, including pink Ache Away packaging and a participating Thrive retail round-up program.

news.headline: Berry In Love Betty introduced as a seasonal strawberry chocolate chew
news.summary: MariMed announced its first swirled Betty’s chew, combining strawberry and chocolate flavors. The announcement included Massachusetts retailers; this dated story does not confirm current stock.

news.headline: Bundle Up Betty’s brought cranberry orange flavors to the winter lineup
news.summary: The winter seasonal announcement described cranberry, orange and warming spices with THC and CBD. Massachusetts was included in the original release; confirm availability before discussing an order.

news.headline: Betty’s Caramelt Away launched in Massachusetts
news.summary: MariMed announced caramel chews infused with full-spectrum hash and CBG, debuting at select Massachusetts retailers ahead of National Caramel Day.
